text:
emma: Quick sync: proposing an "entry safety" MVP for model catalog onboarding. Goal = a tight, checklist-driven playbook that teams can run in <2 hours. Focus: benchmarks, Pin policy, customer opt-ins, deprecation windows, and emergency rollback. Thoughts?

raj: +1. Keep it pragmatic. We need a runnable checklist (commands + small harness) and a clear owner for each gate.

taylor: Suggest three mandatory gates for MVP: 1) perf (p95 & mem), 2) regression (prompt set A/B), 3) economics (cost per 1k tokens). Each gate should be pass/fail with a numeric threshold.

nina: For regression gate: require a paired A/B on our canonical onramp prompts (50-200 samples). Reject if >10% drop in composite score or any critical intent fails.

ben: Pin policy proposal: default = float. If customer requests pin, require a 'pin ticket' with TTL and migration pledge. For non-enterprise, TTL = 60d. For enterprise, TTL negotiable but must be recorded.
emma: I propose differences by deployment: Hosted: enforcement + migration CLI; Dedicated: soft-flagged and 30d notice; Private: legal/contract required, flag visible in catalog UI.

raj: Canary plan (MVP): 5% for 12h, 25% for 24h, 75% for 48h, full 7d. Metric windows: infra (1m), latency (5m rolling), quality (6h batch). Kill conditions: error-rate +3x baseline or quality delta >12% on canary prompts.

taylor: Add warm-cache sanity: if cold-start p95 > target but warm p95 meets it, allow extended warm-up window not immediate rollback.

infra-bot: scheduled-check: 2026-06-20T02:00Z - canary config missing.

nina: For deprecation: 60d notice for floating models, 90d for pinned non-enterprise, 180d for enterprise unless contract says otherwise. Offer migration credits and a migration sprint assist.

ben: Migration tooling: quick-scan that computes per-tenant impact (tokens, model features used, embed schema changes). UI should emit a migration-risk label: OK/Watch/High.

emma: We need a tiny bench snippet for docs (one-liner + small script). Add a CLI example teams can copy.

taylor: bench snippet:```bash
# quickbench.sh
redwood-cli catalog bench --model $MODEL --dataset onboard-mini --metrics p95,tokens,accuracy --output json
```

raj: Rollback/runbook notes: one-command rollback to previous stable alias + auto-notify SRE and product. Trigger list: sustained p95 >2x baseline (10m), error-rate spike >5% absolute, quality regression >15% on canary.

nina: Also require a post-mortem template that includes receptor traces, sample failures, and remediation plan. Attach to pin ticket when rollback occurs.

emma: Action items: emma -> author draft playbook page + checklist; taylor -> define numeric thresholds per family; nina -> canonical prompt sets and regression harness; ben -> UI migration-risk flag + pin ticket schema; raj -> canary config defaults + infra alerts. Target first draft by next Tue EOD.

ben: Customer comms template idea: short email + migration opt-out link + support booking slot. Keep language specific about dates and credits.

taylor: Minor ask: include a small section for experimental models (alpha) that are explicitly flagged as non-SLA and auto-evict after 30d if not promoted.

emma: Great. I'll post the confluence link when draft is done. react with :white_check_mark: if you agree or reply for changes.
